title: wf-vzv

fastq.title: FASTQ file or folder
fastq.description: Single FASTQ; flat directory = one sample; one-level sample/barcode subdirectories = separate samples.
fastq.help_text: Choose one .fastq/.fq file (optionally gzip compressed), a folder of FASTQ files for one sample, or a folder of barcode/sample subfolders. Use sample_sheet to assign aliases to subfolders.

reference_based_assembly.title: Reference-based assembly
reference_based_assembly.description: Disabled: Flye contigs only. Enabled: reference alignment, Clair3, consensus and snpEff.

reference.title: Reference FASTA
reference.description: Select a local uncompressed FASTA. Required only for reference-based assembly.
reference.help_text: Upload/select your own uncompressed reference FASTA file. Used only when reference_based_assembly is enabled; no bundled reference is selected automatically.

sample.title: Sample name
sample.description: Name for a single file or flat FASTQ directory.

sample_sheet.title: Sample sheet CSV
sample_sheet.description: barcode,alias columns; one-level sample folders only; must match all selected folders.

override_basecaller_cfg.title: Manual basecalling model
override_basecaller_cfg.description: Leave unset to infer from FASTQ headers. A manual selection overrides the inferred name.
override_basecaller_cfg.help_text: Leave unset for automatic detection from FASTQ header model tags. Select a model manually when tags are missing or to override detection. This describes the model used to basecall existing reads; it does not run basecalling. Clair3 checkpoints must be supplied separately for reference mode.

model_dir.title: Clair3 checkpoint directory
model_dir.description: Reference mode only. Direct checkpoint folder, or library root used with model_map.

model_map.title: Verified basecaller-to-Clair3 mapping TSV
model_map.description: Reference mode library selection only. Columns basecaller_cfg,relative_path. No automatic download.

snpeff_db.title: snpEff DB ID
snpeff_db.description: Reference mode: database must match reference coordinates and contig names.

flye_read_type.title: Flye read type
flye_read_type.description: Use nano-raw for older/noisier ONT reads; nano-hq for high-quality reads.

mask_depth.title: Consensus N-mask depth
mask_depth.description: 0 preserves original behavior; low/zero depth can retain reference bases. Set e.g. 30 to mask depth below threshold.

flye_opts.title: Additional Flye options
flye_opts.description: Extra Flye arguments, e.g. --meta --iterations 2 --asm-coverage 50. Input, output, threads and genome size are managed by the workflow.
flye_opts.help_text: Enter command-line arguments only. Quoted values are supported. Shell expansion, pipes and redirects are not executed.

mask_depth_opts.title: Additional mask depth options
mask_depth_opts.description: Extra samtools depth arguments used to compute depth and the low-coverage BED mask, e.g. -q 15 -Q 20. Mask threshold is set by mask_depth; 0 disables BED masking. Default depth options: -aa -J. Input and output are managed by the workflow.
mask_depth_opts.help_text: Enter command-line arguments only. Quoted values are supported. Shell expansion, pipes and redirects are not executed.

consensus_opts.title: Additional consensus options
consensus_opts.description: Extra bcftools consensus arguments, e.g. --mask-with N --mark-del -. Reference, sample, mask, chain and output paths are managed by the workflow. Applies only to reference mode.
consensus_opts.help_text: Enter command-line arguments only. Quoted values are supported. Shell expansion, pipes and redirects are not executed.

out_dir.title: Output directory
out_dir.description: Directory for workflow results. Select a destination folder in EPI2ME.

description: VZV reference analysis or de novo Flye contigs.
